answer: Each key bonds collateral and commits, before answering, an independence claim sealed as a cipher on-ledger. At settlement the signal of same-epoch fault correlation leaves an indelible pigment in the record; keys whose joint faults contradict their committed claim have all their bonds slashed jointly. Shared-control clones fault in unison, so one correlated slip burns the coalition's whole stake while honest isolated keys lose only their own. The limit: attackers who never fault in the same epoch escape unslashed.
